description.value: Fish Hook is an Indian-French fusion seafood restaurant on Fort Street in Victoria, specializing in sustainably sourced, locally caught fish prepared with masala curries, house-pickled vegetables, and open-faced tartine sandwiches. The menu reflects an inventive blend of South Asian and West Coast influences, with options ranging from vindaloo mussels to cold-smoked tuna tartines. Both sit-down dining and takeout are available, making it a practical and distinctive lunch or dinner stop for cyclists in the city core.
